title: Dangerous Goods Acceptance: deciding a review
content:
## When this applies
Under the Dangerous Goods Acceptance product, the decision on an acceptance under review falls due from the state of its records; no request by the customer is needed for it. The decision is recorded as approved or rejected, and this policy governs which of the two is recorded, or whether no decision can be recorded yet.

## Business effect
- An approval takes the acceptance from under review to approved: the line accepts the goods for the booking's current sailing, and the approval date is set on the acceptance.
- A rejection takes the acceptance from under review to rejected: the line refuses the goods, and the rejection date is set on the acceptance.
- Where no decision can yet be recorded, the acceptance remains under review.

## Handling
The decision is recorded by the agent through the desk's review-decision action on the acceptance concerned. The decision date is the day on which the decision is recorded.

## Basis Q&A
- *Who records the decision on a review?* The agent, on behalf of the line; the shipper does not decide its own review.
- *Can an acceptance that is not under review be decided under this policy?* The policy governs the decision on an acceptance under review.
